verdict.rationale: Mem0's open-source/self-hosted offering explicitly lets users run the full stack on their own infrastructure and 'choose where each one runs,' which functionally satisfies data residency control (mem0-docs-4, mem0-docs-43, mem0-docs-21). However, for the hosted Platform (the default product), there is no evidence of selectable regions or residency guarantees — missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency options in the hosted Platform, third-party or compliance documentation confirming residency controls, and any UI/API setting to pick a storage region.
